items.text: Eagles officially placed QB Jalen Hurts on injured reserve due to blood clot after doctor consultations; out for foreseeable future. Tanner McKee will start.
items.why: Blood clot in calf; consultations Saturday confirmed need for IR.
items.implication: McKee starts short- and medium-term; Eagles skill players still viable but QB downgrade.
items.opportunity: Backup QB and any elevated RBs; healthy pass-catchers retain roles.

items.text: Patriots officially activated WR A.J. Brown from IR to 53-man roster; expected to play Sunday vs Jets.
items.why: Returned to practice this week after high-ankle sprain IR stint; progressed enough for activation.
items.implication: Start as WR2/flex; boosts Patriots passing game with Drake Maye.
items.opportunity: Primary target share return; monitor snap ramp-up.

items.text: Bears planning to start QB Caleb Williams vs Falcons after full week of practice with no setbacks from torn hamstring (missed prior three games).
items.why: Full practices all week; listed Q but took starter reps and cleared to roll.
items.implication: Upgrade Bears offense and pass-catchers like Rome Odunze; viable QB stream.
items.opportunity: Full starter role return; elevated passing volume potential.

items.text: Ravens officially activated WR Ja’Kobi Lane from IR; expected to play Sunday vs Browns.
items.implication: Depth WR addition with Lamar out; potential target share in Huntley offense.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets if role expands behind Flowers.

items.text: Pick up Tanner McKee wherever available if need QB; will be better than thought, can play. Not worried about any Eagles skill players with McKee under center.
items.why: McKee capable; Eagles top pass-catchers healthy.

items.text: Steelers WR DK Metcalf (illness) removed from injury report; no designation for Sunday vs TB. Freiermuth (calf) added as Q.
items.implication: Full go; heavy usage expected in thin WR room.

items.text: Assuming AJ Brown active for Patriots he'll be active for me; starting him as WR2 wherever rostered.
items.why: Expected activation and play vs Jets.

items.text: Unclear on Qs AJ Brown (ankle), TreVeyon Henderson (ankle), DJ Moore (shoulder). Tyler Warren (groin) Friday addition Q. Bunch of Qs more like probable: Caleb Williams, DK Metcalf, Chris Olave, Rico Dowdle. PIT thin at WR (no Pittman/Wilson/Skowronek) so heavy 2-WR Metcalf + Bernard. PHI McKee has 4th-string RB but healthy top-4 pass-catchers.
items.why: Practice/report reading; PIT personnel, PHI depth.
items.implication: Monitor Brown/Henderson closely; lean in on probable Qs and Metcalf volume; PHI pass-catchers safe.
items.opportunity: Metcalf target share spike; PHI WR/TE stability.

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT (ankle) for Sunday.
items.implication: Tyler Huntley starts; Ravens offense less explosive, lean run/Henry.

items.text: Saquon Barkley listed OUT (hamstring) along with Will Shipley.
items.implication: Eagles RB committee thin; McKee era pass-heavy possible.
items.opportunity: Elevated backups like Jaydon Blue signed.

items.text: Breece Hall listed OUT (quad) with AD Mitchell.
items.implication: Jets RBBC; Braelon Allen or others elevated.
Texans RB volume to others (e.g. Marks).

items.text: Loves Mike Evans vs WSH (WR4) due to Commanders defense being a buffet for pass catchers.
Loves Drake London vs CHI (WR6) with bankable usage.
Loves Kyren Williams vs ARI (RB5); elite recent usage vs leaky run D.
Hates Jaylen Waddle vs SEA (WR28) due to tough matchup and QB issues.
items.why: Ugly SEA matchup and shaky QB.
